posts.name: Vaani Developer Platform
posts.tagline: The only voice AI harness that you'll ever need
posts.description: Build a voice agent that sounds and behaves human without writing a single line of code. Design the call flow, handle objections and edge cases, connect your tools and knowledge base, and go live on a real phone number. Every call ends with clean, structured data.

posts.name: Knocket AI
posts.tagline: Chat with visitors from your website or link
posts.description: Give visitors a way to say hello. Add free live chat to your website or app, or turn your bio link into a personal contact page. Visitors can start chatting without signing up. Built for founders, creators, and small teams.

posts.name: SpeakON Agent
posts.tagline: Turn natural speech into real work for an agent to complete
posts.description: Turn natural speech into real work with SpeakON Agent. It understands your Notes, connects your tools, and prepares Actions for you to review and confirm.

posts.name: MCP Server by XWiki
posts.tagline: Give your AI your wiki's knowledge while keeping the control
posts.description: XWiki MCP Server is an open-source, self-hostable extension that connects XWiki to the AI agent of your choice: OpenCode, Pi, Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and more. You can already use the extension to query your knowledge base to get answers, create and edit pages, and work with structured data directly in XWiki. Try out the extension and let us what's should we improve next!

posts.name: Canva Brush
posts.tagline: A vision-language model that edits your designs
posts.description: Canva Brush is a vision-language model for design from Canva Research. It sees your design, understands how it’s put together, and makes the changes you ask for, from one line of copy to every slide in a deck. Everything stays fully editable. Canva says it’s up to 69% faster and 46% lower cost per edit task than its previous design agent. It’s powering Canva AI design edits for Canva Pro subscribers today.

posts.name: fastbrowse
posts.tagline: Fastest open source browser agent
posts.description: A fast open-source browser agent. It reads every button, link and field on the page and has a System One model (ex: jev) pick the next step from that list. If it's unsure, it falls back to a standard model model. Fast, cheap, and every answer provides a citation.

posts.name: Chopstick
posts.tagline: Mac activity and action widgets that write themselves
posts.description: Chopstick notices what you repeat on your Mac and builds notch widgets for it, using the coding agent you already have. Your activity log stays local.

posts.name: Teable Mobile
posts.tagline: Build the systems your team runs on, now from your phone
posts.description: Explain your process like you would to a new hire. Teable builds the database, the app and the automations, so the work stops living in your head. Now you can do it from your phone: hold to talk, publish to your team, and get notified when it's done.

posts.name: iSurge
posts.tagline: Activity monitor, per-app volume, disk cleanup at your notch
posts.description: iSurge is one app for people who live on their Mac: live stats at the notch, each app's volume and mic, disk clean-up, an uninstaller, dev tools for ports, projects and Homebrew, a focus timer and Keep Awake. $14.99 once, $10.99 with PHPROMO20. No account.

posts.name: Faylee
posts.tagline: Bug reports your coding agent can fix from one link
posts.description: Faylee records the screen, console, every network request and each click behind a bug, on one timeline, and shares it all as one link. Your team opens it and sees exactly what broke, with the failing request already open. Paste the link into Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, and Faylee's MCP server gives the agent the whole report so it can find the cause and fix it. Instant replay saves the last few minutes after a bug already happened. Free for up to 3 members.

posts.name: Nocto
posts.tagline: Your MacBook notch, finally useful
posts.description: Nocto turns your MacBook's notch into a small control center. Hover to see what's playing and skip songs. Ten minutes before a call it starts a countdown, and when the meeting begins the notch opens with a Join button (Zoom, Meet, Teams, Webex, FaceTime). Park files on the shelf, find anything you copied in clipboard history, and check your Mac and AirPods battery at a glance. Native, light, macOS 14+. One-time purchase, 7-day free trial. Music stays free forever.

posts.name: SparkBots AI (Powered by Jev)
posts.tagline: Instantly extract key details and analyze any webpage or PDF
posts.description: SparkBots can be trained to deeply analyze any web page or PDF. Once trained, your Sparkbot can be run on similar pages returning answers in less than a second. Perfect for analyzing and extracting key details for leads, businesses, resumes, listings, contracts or any PDF. SparkBot use AI, but it isn't a slow LLM like Claude or ChatGPT. It can't hallucinate or make up details that don't exist. Every answer comes straight from the content on the page and anything it doesn't find is left blank.

posts.name: ilse
posts.tagline: Point at your app and your AI agent changes the code
posts.description: Ilse puts a toolbar on top of the React app you already have running. Click an element and say what should change, drag to reorder, resize, or tweak spacing and colors with your project's own tokens. Simple tweaks land instantly, with no AI. The rest goes to the agent you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini), pointing at the right spot in the code. Pro adds test mode: Ilse walks real user journeys on her own and reports what breaks.

posts.name: Cluinn
posts.tagline: Answers your questions during the call, not after. For Mac.
posts.description: Someone asks a question on a call and you need the answer now. Cluinn listens on your Mac and answers mid-call from what was just said, with no bot joining the meeting. Smart Cards flag a question nobody answered. When the call ends you get the action items, and Coach shows how the call went against a goal you set. It also does AI dictation: speak, and clean text lands in any Mac app. For Apple silicon Macs. 14-day trial; LAUNCH30 takes 30% off for 12 months.

posts.name: Norah Studio
posts.tagline: A new space to explore your music
posts.description: Norah Studio is a creative studio for exploring, transforming and reimagining your music on Mac, iPad and iPhone. Isolate tracks, loop by bars, adjust tempo and key, follow chords, add effects, build harmonies, turn melodies into instruments and export audio or MIDI. Everything runs on your device. Choose a subscription or a one-time purchase; either unlocks Pro on iPhone, iPad and Mac with the same Apple Account.

posts.name: Axonnic
posts.tagline: Muscle-sensing sleeves for robot training
posts.description: Axonnic’s forearm sleeve records muscle signals to track finger movement and estimate fingertip force. We combine EMG, video and hand pose into training datasets for robot tasks such as sewing, tool handling and delicate assembly.

posts.name: Kestrix
posts.tagline: Repo-agnostic CI control plane with DAG-based triggers.
posts.description: Kestrix defines CI/CD pipelines in HCL and resolves them into a DAG. A task runs only when the repositories its trigger names have changed. Live task logs in a React Flow UI, and remote runners that only make outbound HTTPS requests.

posts.name: StepGrab
posts.tagline: Now on Windows, with redaction and a real editor
posts.description: New since our first launch: StepGrab runs on Windows, and projects open on Mac and PC. Black out emails, names or prices, and the box is burned into every export so nobody can lift it off. Every guide opens in an editor: rewrite steps, add arrows, boxes and text, reorder, undo. The direct Mac download reads the real name of every button you click. Still the core: every click becomes a screenshot, arrow and sentence. No account, nothing uploaded. 5 free Lifetime licenses: see the comments :)

posts.name: StereoLift Live
posts.tagline: your desktop in real 3D, live on your Quest
posts.description: Run StereoLift Live on a Windows or Linux PC with an NVIDIA GPU. View your desktop in stereoscopic 3D on Meta Quest over your local network.

posts.name: sitesolide
posts.tagline: Deploy your vibe-coded apps on your own server
posts.description: You built an app with Claude Code or Cursor and want it online. Run sitesolide deploy in its folder and it goes live on your server, on HTTPS, at its own address. Each app is isolated from the others, and you choose who can open it. Free and open source (MIT): you pay for the server and a domain.

posts.name: Blooper.ai
posts.tagline: AI video workspace that learns from your team
posts.description: Make AI video in one place. Blooper remembers your team’s creative decisions, each iteration spends less tokens.

posts.name: Prosyo
posts.tagline: AI SDR that books meetings - run it from ChatGPT or Claude
posts.description: Prosyo is an AI SDR for B2B outbound. Tell ChatGPT or Claude who you want to meet, and Prosyo does the rest: finds people who fit your ICP, verifies their work email and phone (you only pay for verified contacts), writes openers from what they actually posted, and runs LinkedIn + email in one sequence from your own account. Every reply lands in one inbox, including voice notes & attachments, with a draft answer ready. One tool instead of four, from $19/mo. 7 days free, no card

posts.name: coffeechat.me
posts.tagline: Warm scheduling for real conversations
posts.description: Calendly is great for meetings, but not every conversation is a meeting. coffeechat.me is warm scheduling: one personal link where people can ask you for a virtual or in-person coffee chat, share why they'd love to talk, and you choose who to meet.

posts.name: Relic AI
posts.tagline: Save links, PDFs and videos in one click, then ask them.
posts.description: You saved it somewhere. Relic AI helps you find it again. Save links, PDFs, YouTube videos, notes and open tabs in one click from Chrome, or import from Notion and Google Drive. Relic summarizes and tags every save, then answers your questions only from your Library, with numbered sources. If it isn’t in your saves, it says so. A weekly Digest brings back what’s worth reading next. Built by three founders who kept redoing research they’d already saved. Free during the beta.

posts.name: CaptureHop
posts.tagline: Download your Meta Quest captures over home Wi-Fi
posts.description: Download screenshots and videos from Meta Quest 3 or 3S to your phone, Mac or PC over home Wi-Fi. Pair a browser, browse by game, select captures and keep the original files. Free public beta APK. No CaptureHop account or companion receiver app.

posts.name: Minted
posts.tagline: Turn SVG into a physically-lit 3D gold medallion for SwiftUI
posts.description: Minted turns any SVG into a physically-lit 3D gold medallion for SwiftUI. Cloisonne enamel, engraved lettering, orange-peel backs, and momentum spins, all from generated geometry from your 2D paths, so your app ships zero model files. Hand it finished pin artwork and it traces the outline and renders gold as real metal, or build coins from paths directly. Six sample pins ship with the package. Swift 5.9+, iOS 17+, Swift Package Manager, MIT.

posts.name: opencommerce
posts.tagline: OpenRouter for commerce: one endpoint, every online store
posts.description: opencommerce by Agentcard lets AI agents buy from any online store through a single endpoint: catalogue search, checkout and order tracking in one SDK. Built to be the fastest way for an agent to buy: it searches catalogues and makes purchases in under 20 seconds.

posts.name: AI-Atlas
posts.tagline: Your GitHub’s AI projects, scored from the actual code
posts.description: AI-Atlas evaluates public GitHub code—not stars or followers—to reveal what developers actually build. Every AI project gets an explainable score using a 7-part rubric, mapped across six fields: ML, Computer Vision, Data Science, NLP and LLMs, AI Agents and MLOps. Map any GitHub profile for free. Claim yours to explore file-level evidence, join opt-in global, country and project leaderboards, add a live README badge and get a free improvement roadmap. Built solo by a 17-year-old student.

posts.name: Bento
posts.tagline: Tidy your Mac desktop in one click, and keep it that way
posts.description: Bento files everything on your desktop into real folders, shown as neat boxes. You see the plan first, nothing is deleted, and Undo feature puts files back. New screenshots sort themselves. Search screenshots by their text, fast. $5 once until Nov 6, then $12. macOS 14+.

posts.name: Tadado
posts.tagline: Halloween edition: New Imposter mode and free spooky deck
posts.description: Tadado now has a Halloween edition and a new game mode. Imposter mode: everyone gets the secret word except one player, then you talk, bluff and vote. The whole app was redesigned for Halloween across all 14 languages, including right-to-left Arabic. AI decks turn any topic into a playable deck in seconds, alongside Forbidden Words and Heads Up. The full Halloween deck is free for the Product Hunt community.

posts.name: SpaceWise
posts.tagline: Storage Cleaner for macOS & Windows Developers
posts.description: SpaceWise is a native, privacy-first storage cleaner built for developers on macOS & Windows. Reclaim 40GB+ of Docker layers, Xcode DerivedData, dead node_modules, and AI weights. Features silent menu bar Auto-Clean and an offline AI Folder Explainer with SpaceWise MCP server.

posts.name: JigJoy
posts.tagline: Build an AI agent in one sentence.
posts.description: Describe the job and JigJoy builds the agent: it runs on a schedule, asks before anything risky, and reports to your phone. Free, with no limits when your agents run on the Claude Code, Codex or Devin you already pay for.

posts.name: Pursly
posts.tagline: Personal finance that doesn't feel like homework
posts.description: Pursly is a simple personal finance app for iPhone. Add an expense in seconds, even straight from your lock screen, and see where your money actually goes. No spreadsheets, no clutter. Free on the App Store.

posts.name: BlitzRank
posts.tagline: Turn your website into answers people search for
posts.description: BlitzRank reads your website, suggests topics people search for, and writes each article from passages on your own pages. Nothing goes live until you approve that exact version. A weekly check you run shows whether ChatGPT and Gemini name you.

posts.name: Rabbitflare
posts.tagline: Managed WordPress Hosting on DigitalOcean & More
posts.description: Rabbitflare is fully managed WordPress hosting on DigitalOcean, Vultr, Hetzner or AWS. Free SSL, CDN, firewall and staging, from $12/month.

posts.name: Keepsake
posts.tagline: Write your family’s story together. Print it as a keepsake.
posts.description: Keepsake helps families write stories together and print them as hardcover books. Unlike memoir tools that email one person a weekly question, Keepsake lets the whole family write together with unlimited collaborators, guided questions and photos. New in v2: a fresh look, one dashboard for all your books, colour-coded project pages, finish dates and a smoother path to print.

posts.name: BadLingos
posts.tagline: LEARN THE WORDS THEY DON'T TEACH YOU
posts.description: Slang, insults and swear words from real places, rated from mild to "don't say this to your mother-in-law". Hear native pronunciation, save favourites, and learn region by region. 3 free words per region, unlock a country from $1.99. 18+.

posts.name: Merrylet
posts.tagline: Your dog, your family, painted into a card that plays
posts.description: Greeting cards that pop up, play and unfold on your phone. Add one photo and your dog, cat, kids or partner get painted into the card in its own storybook style: on the drum in the birthday band, or a bronze statue in the town square. Opens in any browser.

posts.name: INVO Ride
posts.tagline: Book autonomous eVTOL flights over 9 photoreal US cities
posts.description: New since our first launch: INVO Ride now flies over 9 photoreal 3D cities (San Francisco, Los Angeles, Las Vegas, Miami, New York, Chicago, Seattle, Boston and Austin) with a new autonomous fleet: the INVO Moon, AREA 51, Mars and Earth. Book a flight like a rideshare and watch it fly gate-to-gate on hexagonal sky lanes, with three speed decks, a fleet that keeps 90 m apart, and building- and airspace-aware routing. Try the live tour, no account needed.

posts.name: SUN for ChatGPT
posts.tagline: Podcasts, music, meditations and stories inside ChatGPT
posts.description: SUN is now inside ChatGPT. Generate podcasts, original songs, guided meditations, micro-dramas, audio courses, and fictional stories for adults and kids, all from a conversation. Describe what you want to hear and turn your ideas into audio without leaving ChatGPT.

posts.name: Agilo
posts.tagline: Planning poker and retros that turn discussion into action
posts.description: Estimate together with Planning Poker, run focused retrospectives, and turn feedback into owned action items. Agilo brings hidden voting, ready-to-use retro templates, Jira estimation, and follow-through into one workspace for agile teams.

posts.name: iQ
posts.tagline: Your quit-smoking tracker. One day at a time
posts.description: Track smoke-free time, get craving support, and turn estimated cigarette savings into personal goals. iQ brings short SOS activities, widgets, Apple Watch support and Siri shortcuts to your day. Available in 51 languages. No account needed. Free to start; optional Premium.

posts.name: mcpscore
posts.tagline: MCP Server Audit & Quality Checker
posts.description: Audit any MCP server and get a 0–100 quality score across protocol conformance, tool quality, security and auth, and spec readiness.

posts.name: ReviewToWeb
posts.tagline: Your Google reviews become a website that takes bookings
posts.description: Paste a Google Maps link. ReviewToWeb builds a finished website for a local business from its own reviews, photos and opening hours, and puts bookings on it: tables for restaurants, a team and services for salons, places per start for tours, or a request form for everyone else. Guests get a reminder the day before and a link to cancel. Flat monthly price, no commission on your guests. The generated website is free. Publishing your edits and bookings are paid, with a 7-day trial.

posts.name: Ugle
posts.tagline: Search across local audio/video archives by meaning, locally
posts.description: Find the exact moment inside any recording, locally on your machine, with no uploads and no cloud. Find what someone said without remembering their exact words. Ugle searches spoken dialogue by meaning across your audio and video archive, returning timestamped passages you can play and verify. Transcription, indexing, and search run on your machine, with no media uploads required and no per-search token fees.

posts.name: TrekMeet
posts.tagline: Hiking Community, Offline Trail Maps & Safety
posts.description: TrekMeet is an offline-first outdoor community app for Australia. Discover trails and events, plan solo or group hikes, and chat with mates in one place. Choose a trail from the library or import a GPX route, download maps before you leave coverage, and keep a record of your walks to your journey. When connected, organisers can share their live location with attendees, and TrekMeet has no ads.

posts.name: Polido
posts.tagline: Tap twice to polish anything you type, in any app
posts.description: Polido rewrites what you type, right where you type it. Write a rough Slack message, email or ChatGPT prompt, tap twice, and it comes back clear and in your voice. Works in any app on Mac and Windows. Free to start.

posts.name: FindUpApp: Better Discovery & 0 Friction
posts.tagline: Deep multi-layer directory, AI categorization & 20 languages
posts.description: Official app stores often bury great indie apps under shallow categories. Since our Beta, FindUpApp has transformed into a discovery platform that gives every mobile app a fair chance to be found. What’s new: • Deep Multi-layered Categories & Secondary Category support • Next-Gen AI Auto-Categorization & 20 languages • Smart Discovery Engine to surface related apps • RSS feed support for category tracking Zero-friction listing — no sign-up needed.

posts.name: BlueArch
posts.tagline: Your AI Solutions Architect.
posts.description: FinOps & Cloud Governance tools that fit the workflow you already have - AI native, Open Source, & BYOC.

posts.name: SiteFolio
posts.tagline: Your CV as a page people actually open.
posts.description: Stop cold-sending your CV. Share one link people can scroll, and download the PDF when they care.

posts.name: Holly
posts.tagline: Holistic budgeting without the guilt or guesswork.
posts.description: Traditional budgeting apps scold you for spending and treat you like a child. Holly is built for UK millennials and Gen Z who want a holistic view of their money without the guilt or spreadsheets. It automatically ring-fences your rent and bills to give you a crystal-clear daily safe-to-spend number. Key features include automated bill protection, 90-day financial forecasting, and instant purchase simulation. Stop dreading your bank app and take back control.

posts.name: Sleep Hours Calculator
posts.tagline: Wake up refreshed using natural 90-minute sleep cycles.
posts.description: Use our free sleep hours calculator and sleep calculator to find the best time to sleep or wake up. Plan natural sleep cycles with zero sign up.

posts.name: Confible
posts.tagline: SSH, databases, S3 and Redis in one desktop app
posts.description: One window for every server you own: SSH and a local terminal, SFTP, Postgres/MySQL/SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis, S3, RDP, queues and Kubernetes, as tabs. End-to-end encrypted sync. $89 once, 14-day trial, no card.

posts.name: Moti
posts.tagline: Fitness Challenges that Pay
posts.description: Compete in fitness challenges, prove your workouts, beat your friends and win real money. Moti is the fitness challenge app that keeps you motivated.

posts.name: Horidori
posts.tagline: Learn Korean culture through stories and quizzes
posts.description: Read stories about Korean food, music and history, then answer five questions with explanations. Available in English, Korean and Japanese. Start with 97 free stories on Android. One optional purchase opens three more.

posts.name: The Merchant Engine
posts.tagline: Open-Source, Self-Hosted Shopify Alternative
posts.description: A self-hosted ecommerce platform for developers who build stores for clients: a NestJS REST API on PostgreSQL and Redis, an Angular admin dashboard and a server-rendered Analog.js storefront in French, English and Arabic, installed on your own Linux server with one setup command.

posts.name: SecAIQ Watch for Mac
posts.tagline: A local security monitor for the AI tools on your Mac
posts.description: SecAIQ Watch shows which AI tools run on your Mac, what files and permissions they can reach, which MCP servers they use and where their traffic goes. Read-only, 100% local, no account. 14-day free trial, then $19.99/year.

posts.name: Tetriz Engineering Kit
posts.tagline: Open-source tools for everything around AI coding
posts.description: Agents write code. Help your team plan, understand, ship, and run it. 10 MIT-licensed tools for agent workflows, codebase learning, local CI, observability, tenant isolation, RPC access, log redaction, messaging, and GitHub attachments.

posts.name: TonePerfect
posts.tagline: Which dragon are you? A 60-second accent check
posts.description: If English* isn’t your native language - try our free accent test. TonePerfect listens to your voice and identifies your pronunciation, sound by sound in just 60 seconds. It’s fast, free, and accurate. Which dragon did you get, and what sound gave you away? (*or Mandarin, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, and Korean)

posts.name: Lights Down
posts.tagline: Pick tonight's movie, solo or with someone
posts.description: Most movie pickers make you both swipe the same deck. Lights Down blends your taste and theirs into one list for tonight, from the services you already pay for. About a minute of swiping learns your taste and ends with which of twelve Cinematic Archetypes™ you are. Then pick a mood and get a short list of movies and series, with where each one is streaming. Solo or with someone, everything you need to pick tonight's movie is free, with no ads.

posts.name: Dovey
posts.tagline: Make 100+ static ads using Claude or ChatGPT, in minutes
posts.description: The most successful brands create and test 100+ ads every week. You can hire an ad agency, but that costs over $20k a month. You can use AI image or video models, but they often change how your product looks: the words get scrambled and the shape gets warped. Dovey is an ads studio built for you and your AI agents. It gives your agents a canvas and real design tools, so it uses your actual product photo and produces hundreds of on-brand ads in just minutes, and every ad stays fully editable.

posts.name: Orion Workers
posts.tagline: AI Manager on WhatsApp for you and your company
posts.description: Orion is an AI manager that works where you already do: WhatsApp, Telegram and voice. Send it whatever comes in, like voice notes, PDFs, photos or what you agreed with a client, and it files it, finds it when you ask and follows up for you. Every morning it tells you what needs you today. It works with your Google or Microsoft 365 email, calendar and documents, and nothing goes out without your yes. Built for one-person businesses and companies of 10 to hundreds of people.

posts.name: PostFlow
posts.tagline: A LinkedIn post you'd actually publish, out
posts.description: One line in. A LinkedIn post you'd actually publish, out.

posts.name: Wavoice
posts.tagline: Connect WhatsApp voice calls to Livekit agents in 1 min.
posts.description: Give your AI voice agents a phone line on WhatsApp. 📞 Connect WhatsApp Business calls to your AI voice stack in as little as 90 seconds. With WAVoice, you can: ⚡ Connect LiveKit, Dograh and other voice AI frameworks. 📞 Let AI agents receive real WhatsApp voice calls. 🔌 Skip complex WebRTC, SDP and webhook setup. 🛠️ Get started with a simple open-source CLI. Bring your voice AI to WhatsApp without building calling infrastructure from scratch.

posts.name: MentionReach
posts.tagline: See if ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude recommend your product
posts.description: More people ask AI assistants "what's the best X?" instead of Googling. MentionReach shows if ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude recommend your app or website. Paste a URL, get real buyer questions for your category, and see visibility, average rank, share of voice, the pages AI cites, and concrete fixes. 20 free credits, no card. Credits never expire.

posts.name: Couple Spark: Relationship App
posts.tagline: LONG DISTANCE RELATIONSHIP GAMES
posts.description: 💞 LOVE COMPATIBILITY & ZODIAC MATCH Couple Spark calculates real birth charts from your date, time and place of birth. Then it compares your Sun, Moon, Venus and Mars to show your love compatibility: emotional, communication, passion and trust. It's astrology for couples, built on real astronomy rather than generic horoscopes.

posts.name: TrueLaunch
posts.tagline: TrueLaunch: honest reviews for apps and games
posts.description: TrueLaunch helps indie developers and startups get their apps and games discovered and collect honest feedback. Features include instant app listings, structured reviews, community upvotes, launch-day rankings, developer replies, and reviewer reputation. Every review highlights what worked, what could be better, and what broke. No rating swaps or fake praise—just real feedback to help makers improve their products. Discover, launch, and improve for free.

posts.name: BitTool Signer
posts.tagline: Turn a spare phone into an offline crypto signer
posts.description: Turn a spare phone into an offline transaction signer. BitTool Signer keeps keys on the offline device and exchanges signing requests and signatures by QR. Supports Bitcoin, EVM, Solana and TRON, with public source and a separate online companion.

posts.name: FORCE: Workout & Gym Tracker
posts.tagline: Know what to lift next and when to train again
posts.description: See which muscles are ready, what to lift next, and when to take a lighter week. FORCE uses your logged sets to guide weight, reps and rest, with programs that adapt to your recovery. Apple Watch detects supported exercises and counts reps; you review each set before logging it. Track strength progress, meals, macros, cardio, body measurements, sleep and heart rate together. For iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch, with optional Apple Health sync.

posts.name: Encore
posts.tagline: TikTok slideshows that already work, remade for your app
posts.description: Paste your App Store or Google Play link. Encore finds the most viewed TikTok slideshows in your niche and makes new ones in that format, featuring your app.

posts.name: NapPilot
posts.tagline: Schedule your PC's shutdown, sleep, restart and wake-up.
posts.description: NapPilot: schedule shutdown, restart, sleep and wake on Windows and macOS. Free, local, auto-updating.

posts.name: Email Provider Filter
posts.tagline: Email Provider Lookup & Domain Checker
posts.description: Bulk email validation and provider identification tool. Checks MX and SPF DNS records to determine the mail provider behind email domains.

posts.name: BluRelay.app
posts.tagline: Field Service Operations, Unified & Automated
posts.description: BluRelay unifies field service operations for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and mechanical contractors. Replace disconnected tools with one platform for AI-powered call answering and dispatch, scheduling, technician tracking, payroll validation, QuickBooks integration, customer booking, safety documentation, and more. Reduce admin work, catch payroll discrepancies before payday, capture more service opportunities, and keep your office and field teams connected.

posts.name: RuleFix
posts.tagline: Your AI coding agent, now compliance-aware
posts.description: RuleFix gives Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf a compliance brain over MCP. It catches DPDP, GDPR, SOC 2, HIPAA and PCI DSS issues as code is written, suggests fixes, and only closes an issue after re-scanning proves it's gone.

posts.name: SiteSpin
posts.tagline: AI website builder that builds your website in minutes
posts.description: An AI-built website for your business, with bookings, a shop and payments. Pro includes an eligible domain and renewal while you subscribe. Update it by chat.

posts.name: DirectHireAI
posts.tagline: Search company career pages directly
posts.description: An AI job-search tool that searches employers' own career sites directly and scores each role against your résumé.

posts.name: Grantlark
posts.tagline: Grant alerts matched to what your company does
posts.description: Thousands of funding programmes are open across Europe right now, spread over the EU portal and national catalogues in nine countries. Grantlark reads all of them every hour and scores each one against what your company does. Paste your website, check the profile it drafts, and get a ranked feed plus a daily email. Paid plans add one written sentence on why each programme fits and drop the ones you ruled out. Free plan covers every register. No card.

posts.name: MusicMV
posts.tagline: AI music to video. Editable, free trial, no subscription.
posts.description: MusicMV is an AI music video generator. Turn a song and photo into a beat-synced video with lip-sync. Try free with 20 credits. No subscription or recurring charges. Edit or replace shots for 13 days after completion. Buy credits for watermark-free downloads.

posts.name: UppMatch
posts.tagline: Generate high-quality dating profile photos in minutes
posts.description: UppMatch uses AI to turn your photos or selfies into realistic, high-quality dating profile photos in minutes. Choose from proven dating photo templates, generate dozens of photos in different outfits and settings, and upgrade your Tinder, Hinge, or Bumble profile without hiring a photographer.

posts.name: QRAnalytica 2.0
posts.tagline: Dynamic QR codes with live scan maps, plus an Android app
posts.description: QRAnalytica is rebuilt from the ground up. Make dynamic QR codes for menus, flyers, packaging and signs, change where they point without reprinting, and see every scan by time, city, country and device. New in this launch: a redesigned dashboard, a live 3D scan map, trend charts, a restaurant setup wizard with bulk branded codes, simpler Starter, Business and Lifetime plans, and an Android app that syncs with your web account. 7-day free trial.

posts.name: FredSpeak - Speak English
posts.tagline: Practice Your English Online - No signup needed.
posts.description: You know the English rule. Now put it into practice. 👋 FredSpeak helps you build confidence with: 🎙️ AI-powered pronunciation feedback 🎧 Listening exercises with transcripts 🧩 Short grammar lessons and quizzes 🌍 English for travel, work, and daily life 📈 Progress tracking and personalized practice suggestions Try FredSpeak as a Guest—no signup needed.

posts.name: ASCII Studio - Photo Editor
posts.tagline: ASCII Art & Glitch Video Maker
posts.description: Turn any photo or video into living ASCII art. ASCII Studio rebuilds your photos and videos out of characters, dots, blocks and lines, then brings them to life with motion. Pick a photo or a clip, choose a style, tune it, and export a still, a looping video or a GIF in seconds.

posts.name: Dream-1 by Dream Labs
posts.tagline: Give new robots an AI brain without training from scratch
posts.description: Dream-1 is Dream Labs' World Action Model that gives compatible robots the ability to perform tasks without robot-specific training. Connect a two-armed robot with parallel grippers to its API, provide camera observations and instructions, and Dream-1 generates the actions. It generalizes across new robots, tasks, and environments, with optional fine-tuning when needed. Available in public research beta starting at $3/hour, plus a playground for trying real and simulated robots.

posts.name: Unify API Integrations Pro Edition
posts.tagline: UnifyAPI simplifies integrations for your business workflows
posts.description: UnifyAPI lets developers connect to multiple third-party services using one API. Instead of integrating Stripe, PayPal, CRMs, email services, and shipping providers individually — they connect once and access everything through one interface. What problem it solves Integrating external APIs is messy: Different formats Different authentication Different webhooks Different error handling UnifyAPI standardizes all of it.

posts.name: PM People to Follow by AllthingsPM
posts.tagline: 190+ product people worth following, and where to find them
posts.description: A free directory of 190+ product leaders, authors and builders worth following, from Lenny Rachitsky and Marty Cagan to Teresa Torres and Ethan Mollick. Filter by platform (X, LinkedIn, newsletters, YouTube, podcasts) or by area of product, and follow each one in a click.

posts.name: Capylite
posts.tagline: An expense tracker for you and your household
posts.description: Capylite is an expense tracker that helps you stay on top of what you spend and what you owe, on your own or with your household. It works offline and installs from your browser, and most of its features are free with no ads.

posts.name: Lemody
posts.tagline: Sing along to any song and see your pitch live
posts.description: Lemody is a free singing practice app in your browser. Pick a song, sing along, and watch your voice drawn live on the real melody with word-timed lyrics. Get a score for pitch, rhythm and tone, and climb today's top 100.

posts.name: TaskOpp
posts.tagline: Post a task, set your price. Taskers keep 100%.
posts.description: Most task apps take a 20–30% cut from the people doing the work. TaskOpp charges no commission, ever. Post what you need done (moving help, cleaning, yard work, handyman jobs) and set your own price; a local tasker unlocks it, chats with you, and keeps every dollar. Launching first in Dallas–Fort Worth. Live on the web and Android, iPhone app coming soon.

posts.name: Poster Grammar
posts.tagline: AI design agent for intentional marketing creatives
posts.description: Poster Grammar turns a product and a brief into listings, social posters and ads, with an AI Art Director and a layout engine that checks the result.

posts.name: InterviewSoon
posts.tagline: AI résumé makeovers and mock interviews out loud
posts.description: Your résumé gets you in the door. What you say in the interview makes the difference. InterviewSoon combines an AI résumé makeover with voice-based mock interviews. Improve your résumé, pick a layout, then practice answers out loud and get feedback before the real thing.

posts.name: Everpin
posts.tagline: A private map of every place you've been, on iPhone
posts.description: A private map of every place you've been, on iPhone and iPad. Drop a pin, keep the photo, and watch the countries fill in.

posts.name: Linkeddit
posts.tagline: See where AI answer engines recommend competitors over you
posts.description: See why buyers choose your competitors. Track what they ship, where their customers are unhappy, and when AI recommends them instead of you.

posts.name: Waddle World
posts.tagline: Meta's AI virtual pet that turns your day into a diary
posts.description: Waddle World is Meta's cozy AI-powered virtual pet app that makes journaling feel like play. Hatch a pixel pet, feed it, play mini-games, and tell it about your day through voice or text. As your pet gets to know you, it turns your conversations into illustrated journal entries and postcards. No streaks, no pressure, and no subscriptions — just a little world to return to whenever you feel like it. Free on iOS and Android.

posts.name: Ramulus
posts.tagline: Super visual Git for vibe coding (Free and open-source)
posts.description: Your AI agent writes the code; you keep visual control of the flow. Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or opencode run beside the graph, every edit shows up as a diff, and you stage block by block and merge by dragging. Run npx ramulus. No account. MIT.

posts.name: Meander
posts.tagline: Smart Eye rest reminders for Mac
posts.description: Gentle eye break reminders for Mac, that know not to interrupt calls, videos, games, screen sharing and typing.
